system.description: Beginning at 17th level, your authority on the battlefield becomes absolute, unyielding and instinctive. Your mere presence shatters doubt and rewrites the fates of your allies as your word is law. When a member of your Squad, other than yourself, fails a saving throw of any kind, you can spend 2 Superiority Die and your Reaction. When you do, they instead automatically succeed, suffering no additional effects. A creature can gain the benefit of this feature once per initiative.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
